Welcome to Turnfurlong Infant School
On behalf of the children, staff and Governors, I would like to take the opportunity to welcome you to Turnfurlong Infant School.
All children are unique and the caring ethos at our school supports every child as they take the next step on their learning journey. By working closely alongside parents, carers and families, we can make sure that each child’s education gets off to a great start.

Wraparound and Holiday Care
Little Rascals Wrap around and Holiday care is owned and run by Zoe Adams, a teacher of 20 years, along with other qualified childcare practitioners who all possess an enhanced DBS and safeguarding certificate. The majority of staff also have Paediatric First Aid and Food Hygiene certificates.
The Breakfast Club runs from Monday to Friday from 7.30 am, term time only, and provides Turnfurlong Infant & Junior School children with a nutritious breakfast consisting of cereals, toast, crumpets, pancakes and milk or water. Please note that the children must be dropped off by 7.55 am in order for them to eat breakfast with us. Breakfast club sessions cost £5 per day.
The After School Club runs from Monday to Thursday until 6.00 pm, and Fridays until 5.00 pm. There is an option to book your child in with us until 5.00 pm or 6.00 pm Monday-Thursday and until 5 pm on Fridays. The After School Club provides the children with a vast range of activities to enjoy and extend their learning experiences based around the 'theme of the week'. These activities include; arts and crafts, sports, board games, puzzles, Lego, Shopkins, Paw Patrol, trains and action figures and dolls, to name a few. These well-planned activities will bring out their creative and innovative side whilst providing a safe and friendly environment, ensuring that the welfare and needs of each child are met.
The cost per session is £9.25 until 5.00 pm and £13.25 until 6.00 pm. This includes a substantial snack (beans/spaghetti hoops on toast /crumpet / crackers / rice cakes with jam, butter, cheese, ham, chicken or marmite on toast, and a piece of fruit/veg) to keep them going until dinner.
Lastly, our Holiday Club usually operates on three days in each of the half term holidays (Tuesday - Thursday), one week at Easter and 2-3 weeks in the Summer. We do not open over the Christmas period. The holiday dates for this academic year 2026-27 are as follows:
October half term: Tuesday 27th - Thursday 29th October 2026
February half term: Tuesday 16th - Thursday 18th February 2027
Easter: Monday 5th April - Thursday 8th April 2027
May half term: Tuesday 1st - Thursday 3rd June 2027 Summer: Monday 26th - Friday 30th July 2027
Monday 9th - Friday 13th August 2027
Monday 23rd - Friday 27th August 2027
Please contact Zoe at Little Rascals for further information.
